Specification: This module defines a collection of pure helper operators for constructing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript strings in TLA+. It models string-template filling, concatenation of string sequences, and generation of common HTML fragments such as documents, headers, bodies, frames, grids, boxes, circles, SVG blocks, stylesheets, and script snippets. The specification is not a state-transition system and contains no variables, actions, temporal properties, fairness conditions, or fault model; it is a library-style module focused on deterministic string construction from arguments.
